parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database you want to back up.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DRDS instance to which the destination database belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds remove-drds-db --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds RemoveDrdsDb --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --DbName test
